title: External System Integrations
summary: This module provides utilities for integrating with external tools and libraries, such as hyperparameter search platforms (WandB), experiment tracking (DVCLive), and efficient fine-tuning methods (PEFT). It enables seamless interaction between models and these external systems.

nodes.label: WandB Backend
nodes.title: WandB Hyperparameter Search
nodes.description: Manages integration with Weights & Biases for hyperparameter optimization, including running search and defining parameter spaces for model training.

nodes.label: DVCLive Callback
nodes.title: DVCLive Experiment Tracking
nodes.description: A TrainerCallback that logs training metrics, parameters, and model checkpoints to DVCLive for experiment tracking and data versioning.

nodes.label: PEFT Adapter Mixin
nodes.title: PEFT Adapter Management
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for loading, adding, activating, and managing PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning) adapters within models, supporting various PEFT methods like LoRA.

nodes.label: Weights & Biases
nodes.title: Weights & Biases Platform
nodes.description: An external platform for experiment tracking, visualization, and hyperparameter optimization, integrated via WandbBackend.

nodes.label: DVCLive
nodes.title: DVCLive Library
nodes.description: An external library for experiment tracking and data versioning, used by DVCLiveCallback.

nodes.label: PEFT Library
nodes.title: PEFT Library
nodes.description: An external library providing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning methods, leveraged by PeftAdapterMixin for model adaptation.

nodes.label: Trainer
nodes.title: Model Training Utility
nodes.description: The core utility that orchestrates the training and evaluation loops for models, interacting with callbacks and adapters.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Pre-trained Model Architectures
nodes.description: Various pre-trained model architectures that can be extended or fine-tuned using PEFT adapters.

groups.label: Experiment Tracking & Hyperparameter Search
groups.title: Experiment Tracking & Hyperparameter Search
groups.description: Components facilitating the tracking of experiments and optimization of hyperparameters using external platforms.

groups.label: Model Adaptation
groups.title: Model Adaptation with PEFT
groups.description: Utilities for efficiently adapting and fine-tuning large models using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods.
